title: Well-formedness of the unrolled circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a sequential Boolean circuit with combinational part $C$, and let $T$ be a nonnegative integer. If each gate of $C$ has distinct input vertices and every NOT gate of $C$ has exactly one input, then each gate in the directed acyclic circuit obtained by unrolling $M$ through time $T$ has distinct input vertices, and every NOT gate in that circuit has exactly one input.
hypotheses_covered: The combinational part is well formed: each gate has distinct input vertices and each NOT gate has exactly one input
